question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**a**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Yoga: Meditation and Breathing'.
 
• The most appropriate **article** for the given blank is "**a"**.
 
• 
 
The sentence states that yoga is **a **5,000-year-old Indian body of knowledge. By using "a," it suggests that yoga is one among many body of knowledge that exists, emphasizing its unique and specific nature.

 
 
• 
 
"The" would imply that there is only one 5,000-year-old Indian body of knowledge, which may not be accurate.

 
 
• 
 
Using "a" in this context allows for the possibility of other bodies of knowledge existing alongside yoga. It acknowledges that yoga is a specific body of knowledge without implying exclusivity.

 

Correct Passage:__ *If you thought that yoga was all about bending and twisting your body in odd shapes, it’s time to rethink. Yoga is much more. In very simple words, giving care to your body, mind and breath is yoga. Derived from the Sankrit word ‘yuj’ which means ‘to unite or integrate’, yoga is **a **5,000-year-old Indian body of knowledge. Yoga is all about harmonising the body (5) ______ the mind and breath through means of various breathing exercises, yoga poses (asanas) and meditation.*
